title: AMD and OpenAI Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy 6 Gigawatts of AMD GPUs
summary: AMD and OpenAI are partnering to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure.
why_included: This partnership between AMD and OpenAI signifies a major investment in AI infrastructure, with AMD GPUs powering OpenAI's next-generation models.

title: OpenAI banned PRC-origin operation using AI for regional influence
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a PRC-origin operation, dubbed 'Nine-emdash Line', that used AI to create regional influence content about the South China Sea, Hong Kong, and US politics.
why_included: This details the use of AI in sophisticated influence operations with specific geopolitical targets and OpenAI's enforcement actions.

title: OpenAI banned Russia-origin operation using AI for recidivist influence
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a Russia-origin operation, dubbed 'Stop News', that used AI to generate recidivist influence content targeting Africa and the UK.
why_included: This illustrates the cross-border application of AI for influence campaigns and OpenAI's measures to disrupt them.

title: OpenAI banned PRC-linked accounts using AI for surveillance and influence
summary: OpenAI banned PRC-linked accounts that used AI to support surveillance-related planning, targeted profiling, and research on critics.
why_included: This reveals the concerning use of AI for espionage and the suppression of dissent, alongside OpenAI's enforcement actions.

title: OpenAI banned Korean-language accounts using AI for malware development
summary: OpenAI banned Korean-language accounts that used AI for malware development support, debugging, phishing, and credential-theft workflows.
why_included: This highlights the use of AI in developing and facilitating cybercrime, and OpenAI's efforts to curb such activities.

title: OpenAI banned accounts using AI for phishing and scripting workflows
summary: OpenAI banned accounts involved in activities consistent with PRC intelligence requirements, using AI to support phishing and scripting workflows.
why_included: This points to AI being used in state-sponsored cyber operations, specifically for phishing and scripting, and OpenAI's countermeasures.

title: OpenAI banned Russian-speaking accounts using AI for malware tooling
summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely linked to Russian-speaking criminal groups using AI to build malware loaders, evasion layers, credential-theft scripts, and C2 infrastructure.
why_included: This demonstrates AI's role in enabling sophisticated cybercrime operations by Russian-speaking groups and OpenAI's detection and banning efforts.

title: OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI
summary: OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI to support scam scripts, impersonation, translation, and victim engagement.
why_included: This highlights the broad application of AI in facilitating various forms of online fraud and OpenAI's actions to mitigate these threats.
